name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for AI discoverability and on-site engagement. Accepts a URL, runs read-only checks across 4 skill domains, and emits a structured JSON findings report.
author: Shubham Kumar
_allowed_tools_note: Per the agentskills.io spec (v1, experimental), allowed-tools is declared per-skill in each SKILL.md frontmatter, not at the marketplace level. All skills in this marketplace need 'Read' (to load reference files and scripts) and 'Bash' (to execute Python scripts that make HTTP requests). There is no separate 'http_request' tool in the spec — HTTP calls are made by Python scripts invoked via Bash. See https://agentskills.io/specification for the canonical spec.

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Composes all sub-skills and emits the final JSON audit report.

skills.name: bot-crawlability-audit
skills.description: Audits AI crawler access: robots.txt, live bot probes, llms.txt, WAF detection.

skills.name: structured-data-audit
skills.description: Validates JSON-LD schema.org markup, entity identity, and sameAs disambiguation.

skills.name: citability-freshness-audit
skills.description: Scores content extractability, freshness, trust signals, and detects AI cloaking.

skills.name: engagement-ux-audit
skills.description: Checks heading hierarchy, readability, CTA, Open Graph metadata. Detects JS-render gaps.
